title: Thought Economics (Dr. Vikas Shah MBE DL) — Eric: 'Governance is not bureaucracy — it is the most important product a founder will ever design'
summary: Dr. Vikas Shah MBE DL — the Manchester-based businessman, philosopher, and long-running Thought Economics interviewer — publishes a 30-minute pre-launch interview with Eric on Incorruptible. Covers governance as product, the golden-goose problem, and why founders who don't reckon with success are almost guaranteed to lose control.
blockquote: Governance is not bureaucracy — it is the most important product a founder will ever design.
